# Triage the Inbox

## Inputs

- the active plan root `INBOX.md`;
- any related backlog, roadmap, capability, research, or system context needed to classify an item.

## Outputs

- a deliberate triage outcome for each reviewed item;
- lightweight retained entries when an idea moves to backlog or research;
- no silent promotion into active implementation scope.

## Procedure

For each untriaged item, choose one outcome:

- discard;
- research;
- backlog;
- merge with an existing retained idea;
- promote into roadmap shaping.

Apply these rules:

- do not promote ideas silently into active scope;
- keep backlog entries lightweight;
- preserve the link back to the original Inbox item when an idea is retained.

## Escalate when

- triage reveals a conflict with the active slice or milestone assumptions;
- an item would materially change project intent rather than future sequencing.
